name: bar-chart
title: Bar chart
description: Values per category or period as bars, grouped or stacked, vertical or horizontal.

when: Comparing values across categories or periods.
Explaining a change between two totals.

instead.when: A ranked list of names with values reads better.

keyboard.does: Moves between data points; the tooltip follows.

builtIn: A "Show as table" button shows the same data as a table, which screen readers get by default.
youProvide: A title that says what the figure is.

genui.description: Values per category. Rows are categories or periods; categories are the numeric columns (a stack holds at most five).

title.description: What the chart shows ("Income and expenses"), over it; leave it out when a card or a heading already says so.

index.description: The x key: the period or category of each row.

categories.description: The series keys, in order; the first is the product's own figure (`ds-chart-1`).

BarChart.name: title
BarChart.description: What the chart shows ("Income and expenses"), over it; leave it out when a card or a heading already says so.

BarChart.name: aria-label
BarChart.description: Names the chart when it has no visible `title`.

BarChart.name: period
BarChart.description: The period it covers ("September 2026").

BarChart.name: emptyState
BarChart.description: Shown instead of the plot when there is no data: an `EmptyState size="small"` or text; "No data" by default.

BarChart.name: start
BarChart.description:
The opening total ("Opening balance"), a total bar from zero; the running total starts at 0 without it. A
start without a finite value (NaN, ±Infinity) is left out the same way, with a warning in the console: no
start bar, the running total starts at 0, and the end total is the finite steps' sum (never NaN).

BarChart.name: steps
BarChart.description:
The changes, in order: a positive value raises the running total, a negative one lowers it, and a zero leaves
it (a neutral step: a flat 1.5px line at the running total, labeled "€ 0" with no sign, and no legend key of
its own). Steps without a finite value are left out, with a warning in the console. When nothing moves off
zero (no step, or every figure zero, start included), the chart counts it as nothing measured and shows the
empty state.

BarChart.name: endLabel
BarChart.description: The closing total's name ("Net"): a total bar from zero to the start plus every step.

BarChart.name: valueFormatter
BarChart.description:
Shared by the axis, the labels, the tooltip and the table ("€ 48.920"). Changes and a negative total are
formatted by their size with a `+` or `−` before them, so the formatter sees non-negative values there.

BarChart.name: height
BarChart.description: The plot's height in px; 240 by default.

BarChart.name: type
BarChart.description: `waterfall`: a start, the steps up and down, and the end, each bar starting where the last one ended.

BarChart.name: tableView
BarChart.description:
How the data is offered as a table. `swap` (default): a toggle at the end of the chart's top row turns the plot
into the table at the same height, scrolling inside, so the card never grows. `hidden`: no toggle; the table is
there for screen readers only. `none`: no table at all, for a chart that is already text (BarList).

BarChart.name: isTableOpen
BarChart.description: The table is showing (`swap`), controlled; or `defaultTableOpen` + `onTableOpenChange`.

BarChart.name: total
BarChart.description: The headline figure, in `metric-medium` ("€ 184,2k").

BarChart.name: index
BarChart.description: The x key: the period or category of each row.

BarChart.name: categories
BarChart.description: The series keys, in order; the first is the product's own figure (`ds-chart-1`).

BarChart.name: labels
BarChart.description: Series names by key ("web" → "Website"); the key by default.

BarChart.name: indexFormatter
BarChart.description: The index label in the tooltip and the table ("August 2026").

BarChart.name: indexLabel
BarChart.description: The index column's header in the data table; "Period" for time charts, "Category" for BarChart.

BarChart.name: allowDecimals
BarChart.description:
`false` for whole counts (orders, new customers): the value axis steps by whole numbers, so a small count
reads 0 / 1 / 2 / 3, never 0.7 / 1.4 / 2.1. Fractional steps by default. Percent bars keep their
0–100% steps.

BarChart.name: layout
BarChart.description: `horizontal` for long category names, ranked; `vertical` columns by default.

BarChart.name: comparison
BarChart.description: A comparison series (last year): `ds-chart-neutral`.

BarChart.name: sortBy
BarChart.description: Horizontal bars are sorted by their total unless the categories have a natural order (`none`).

BarChart.name: referenceLines
BarChart.description: An average or target line.
